defeats.how: Goliath kept the other Avengers out of it and fought the Swordsman one on one, but the Swordsman beat him and captured him.
defeats.evidence: The Swordsman defeats Goliath and captures him

defeats.how: While the Swordsman and Egghead fought each other over payment, Goliath regained consciousness and easily defeated both crooks.
defeats.evidence: Goliath regains consciousness and easily defeats the two crooks
